name: Chupa Chupa Drink
source:
Main character's neighboring residences are robbed each night. Landlord comes to him and urges to get night guards to observer the situation and possibly catch the criminal. Three young girls agree to become night guards.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角住处附近每晚都会遭窃。房东找到他，建议安排夜间值守，观察情况并伺机抓住犯人。三名少女答应担任夜间警卫。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
